unsupported_claims: The claims that the child receives the same permissions, hooks, memory object, model, MCP connections, and tools depend on implementation details that are described but not demonstrated with supporting code.
The claim that the repository includes tests/test_subagents.py and that the tests make exactly three fake-model calls is implementation-specific and is not independently supported within the draft.
The statement that unknown-tool handling previously caused lookup failures and now returns a specific error object is asserted without showing the relevant implementation or test.
The claim that a child can use skills and MCP tools is qualified in places but is presented elsewhere as a general capability; the exact inheritance behavior should be stated more carefully.
The phrase "parallelization potential" is potentially misleading because the described implementation shows delegation but does not establish concurrent execution.
The statement that the architecture is becoming a "multi-agent or agent-swarm architecture" is interpretive and stronger than the demonstrated single-level parent-child delegation primitive.
